claims: Tiger Woods' Masters victories place him second all-time behind Jack Nicklaus.
Jack Nicklaus has six Masters wins.
Tiger Woods won the 1997 Masters at age 21.
Tiger Woods became the youngest Masters champion ever in 1997.
Tiger Woods won the 1997 Masters by a record margin of 12 strokes.
Tiger Woods secured his second green jacket in 2001.
Tiger Woods completed the "Tiger Slam" in 2001.
Tiger Woods became the only golfer to hold all four professional major titles simultaneously in 2001.
Tiger Woods successfully defended his Masters title in 2002.
Tiger Woods won back-to-back Masters titles.
Tiger Woods won his fourth green jacket in 2005.
Tiger Woods won the 2005 Masters in a playoff against Chris DiMarco.
Tiger Woods won his fifth Masters in 2019.
Tiger Woods' 2019 Masters win was his first major victory in 11 years.
Tiger Woods has recorded 14 top-10 finishes in 20 professional appearances at Augusta National.
